verdict.rationale: Relay offers automation (auto-transfer rules, receipt capture/categorization, sync to QuickBooks/Xero) that speeds up bookkeeping tasks, but there's no evidence of AI-specific automations targeting the month-end 'close the books' workflow (e.g., automated reconciliation, AI-driven categorization, close checklists). missing for 10: explicit AI-driven closing/reconciliation features, month-end close workflow automation, evidence tying automation to faster book closing specifically.
